title: Randomized tree for the counterexample
statement:
A randomized decision tree on three sign-valued coordinates with real-valued output is defined to compute the function $f\colon\{−1,1\}^3\to\bbr$ given by
\[
f(x)=\frac{t+1}{4}+\frac{t}{4}x_1+\frac{t}{4}x_2-\frac14x_0x_1+\frac14x_0x_2+\frac{t-1}{4}x_1x_2,
\qquad t=2+\sqrt3.
\]
The tree has a finite, nonempty seed space with a probability distribution, and every seed selects a deterministic decision tree that computes $f$ on every input.
